Gears of War: E-Day | Adagio
The Locust Horde erupts from beneath the surface of Sera to wage a brutal war against humanity. Set to a haunting rendition of Barber's Adagio for Strings, adapted by Gears of War: E-Day composer Adam Lastiwka, the launch ad captures the horror and human cost of Emergence Day.  
 
Emergence Begins October 6, 2026. Pre-order the Premium Edition: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/gears-of-war-e-day-premium-edition-pre-order/9p2qmwj6xsb6
